rationale:
OWNER RULING 2026-09-03, RFC_060 §3g D3: 'build the missing check and fill the missing data for the sites' — both halves. This is the check. D4 ('a register for each site to avoid AI slop') is why it is scoped to EVERY deployed site rather than to finance-tiered ones.

THE FINDING IT EXISTS FOR IS STRUCTURAL, not a backlog gap. `resolveEvidenceSites` (refresh_evidence_base_action.go:281, fleet query :291) builds the daily evidence-freshness target list as `SELECT site_id FROM site_specs WHERE aspect='evidence_base' AND is_current`. It selects the sites that HAVE a register — the target set is defined by the presence of the very thing whose absence is the defect. So a register-less site is invisible to the freshness sweep, the fact checks and the invalid_banned_claim_pattern detector alike, permanently, and running any of them more often would never reach one. [MEASURED 2026-09-03] no item_type matching %evidence%/%register%/%claim% had ever been filed for an absence — only claims_unverified 47, stale_evidence 10, spec_supplies_claim 2, stale_directory_claim 2, each of which presupposes a register exists. RFC_060 Q1 required registers and nothing enforced or even REPORTED the requirement; loancash.co.uk was found because a person went looking, and 12 deployed sites are in the same state today.

IT IS DB CONFIG, NOT GO, AND THAT IS A DESIGN CHOICE WITH THREE REASONS. (1) Reuse before building: the mechanism already exists and is documented at cmd/scheduler/main.go:274 — a task with fire_message=false is a 'CTE-only task' where the pre_query IS the worker; ten tasks already run this way. (2) DB config is live immediately, Go is inert until an image is rebuilt and rolled, and this estate has a documented case of a detector sitting off for nine days after its blocker cleared. (3) RFC_006's ruled shape for exactly this class: a CI-time check STRUCTURALLY cannot gate live config, so the remedy is a daily RUNTIME one — and absence of a site_specs row is live config.

plan.summary: One additive migration creating the scheduled task `evidence-register-absence`: daily, fire_message=false, enabled, whose pre_query files one `missing_evidence_register` work item per deployed site with no current evidence_base and at least one page. Two guards (task must not already exist; idx_swi_dedup's predicate must still list the seven terminal statuses the pre_query hardcodes) and a DO/RAISE verify asserting exactly one row, fire_message=false, interval 86400, enabled=true, all three report numbers present, and NO 'ON CONFLICT' in the pre_query. Plus a ROLLBACK that removes the task and deliberately LEAVES the filed findings. New item_type, one producer, no automated consumer; registered as CLM-033 in the same commit.
plan.risks:
(1) DAILY RE-FILING was the main hazard and it is measured, not argued. Dedup is by NOT EXISTS against the same seven terminal statuses idx_swi_dedup uses. Proven in one transaction: pass 1 -> missing_total=12, filed_new=12, already_open=0; pass 2 -> 12, 0, 12 with 12 rows total, not 24; pass 3 after cancelling one -> 12, 1, 11 (a dismissed finding returns while the register is still missing, which is correct for a compliance queue).
(2) NOT `ON CONFLICT`, deliberately: idx_swi_dedup is PARTIAL, and an ON CONFLICT inference must restate its predicate exactly or raise 42P10 — the dedup-index/Go-list lockstep this estate has already been bitten by. Guard 2 aborts if that predicate stops listing the seven statuses, so the hardcoded list cannot silently diverge; and the verify block trips on the string 'ON CONFLICT' appearing in the pre_query at all.
(3) THE REPORT IS THREE NUMBERS ON EVERY TICK, and returning no rows when idle would have been shorter. It was rejected because it collapses 'no site is missing a register' with 'sites are missing one but each already has an item open'. That is precisely the omitempty failure this lane spent the day on (RFC_060 §3f). A missing log line now means the task did not run, and missing_total=0 is a positive statement of health.
(4) SCOPE: only status='deployed' (so 17 pool, 3 test and 1 system sites are never filed against) and only sites with at least one page. Filing 12 items on first tick is intended — that is the D3 population, and it is a human-review queue, not dispatchable work.
(5) needs_human_review with an EMPTY handler_agent is deliberate, not unfinished: the posture rung is a Q4 RECORD carrying who declared it and on what basis, and for a sourced/relied_upon site the facts require reading a primary source. Giving it a handler would manufacture the appearance of an automated fix for irreducibly human work. The spec carries the evidence for the decision (page count, distinct page types) and both bars, not a decision.
(6) THE ANTI-SLOP BENEFIT IS BOUNDED and the bound is stated in the item's own spec under `known_bound`: ScanUnregisteredNumbers is gated on ProseNumbersAreClaims(), false for editorialPageTypes (guide, blog-post, tool, game, news-index) and thirdPartyDataComponents. Coverage falls on content/landing/section-index/entity-page/report. That exclusion is measured (blog-post 46 false positives, tool 7, game 4, guide 1+15, news-index 1) and section-index was measured and rejected — it is not a defect to route around, and nothing here should be read as promising number-checking inside guides.
(7) The task is created ENABLED. A detector that ships disabled is a detector that is off, and the verify block refuses enabled=false for that reason. The rollback prefers disabling to deleting, and says so.

edits.rationale: Creates the task. All four guards mutation-killed against the live database before applying: demanding 999 pre-existing task rows aborts; pointing guard 2 at a non-existent index aborts; expecting fire_message=true aborts after the insert; and injecting the string 'ON CONFLICT' into the pre_query trips the verify's own tripwire. The pre_query itself was then run three times in one rolled-back transaction to prove the file / don't-refile / refile-after-cancel arms, with loancash.co.uk correctly absent from the results because it now has a register — the control that shows the check discriminates rather than filing on everything.
edits.sketch:
DO $$ ... IF n <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '742 ABORT: scheduled task evidence-register-absence already exists'; ...
DO $$ -- guard 2: pg_get_indexdef(idx_swi_dedup) must still list complete/verified/rejected/wont_fix/failed/
     -- unresolved/cancelled, or this task's NOT EXISTS and the index disagree about 'already open'
INSERT INTO scheduled_tasks (name, description, target_agent_type, target_topic, fire_message,
  interval_seconds, timeout_seconds, enabled, input_data, pre_query)
VALUES ('evidence-register-absence', '...', 'generic', 'system.agent.generic.requests', false,
        86400, 300, true, '{}'::jsonb, $PQ$
  WITH candidates AS (SELECT s.id, s.domain FROM sites s
     LEFT JOIN site_specs eb ON eb.site_id=s.id AND eb.aspect='evidence_base' AND eb.is_current
     WHERE s.status='deployed' AND eb.id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages p WHERE p.site_id=s.id)),
  fresh AS (SELECT ... FROM candidates c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site_work_items w
     WHERE w.site_id=c.site_id AND w.item_key='missing_evidence_register_'||c.site_id::text
       AND w.status NOT IN (...seven terminal...))),
  ins AS (INSERT INTO site_work_items (...) SELECT ..., 'missing_evidence_register', 'medium', ...,
     jsonb_build_object('why',...,'decide_first',<the posture rung, a Q4 record>,'bar_standard',<attested>,
       'bar_sourced',<cited + fcaquotecheck>,'known_bound',<ProseNumbersAreClaims>,'expect_errors',<4 of 4 lanes>,
       'acceptance_test',<read the row back through a JOIN on sites>), 60, '', 'needs_human_review', ...
     FROM fresh f RETURNING id)
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates)::text AS missing_total,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::text        AS filed_new,
         (SELECT (count(*)-(SELECT count(*) FROM fresh))::text FROM candidates) AS already_open $PQ$);
DO $$ ... fire_message=false, interval=86400, enabled, all three numbers present, and pq NOT LIKE '%ON CONFLICT%' ...

edits.rationale: Removes the task and deliberately LEAVES every missing_evidence_register item it filed: those are findings, and a finding survives the retirement of the detector that found it. It RAISEs a NOTICE naming how many it is leaving, so the operator sees the consequence rather than discovering it later, and the header says plainly that disabling (UPDATE ... SET enabled=false) is usually the right move because deleting loses the pre_query, which is the whole implementation.

CLM-033, in the SAME commit that ships the mechanism, per the standing rule. It is also the condition the owner ruling of 2026-08-02 §1 attaches to a new item_type: the producer set (one — this task) and the item_key shape ('missing_evidence_register_'||site_id) are named there, which is what keeps this out of architecture scope. The entry carries the structural finding, the two bars, the measured bound on the anti-slop benefit, and the three-arm/four-mutation proof. Index row added in the same commit.

resolveEvidenceSites (refresh_evidence_base_action.go:281, fleet query :291) selects FROM site_specs WHERE aspect='evidence_base' AND is_current — the target set is the sites that HAVE a register.

cmd/scheduler/main.go:274 'CTE-only tasks: pre_query did the work, no Kafka message needed' — plus :212, the no-rows-is-a-successful-no-op branch, and the bugs_open/083 note that the pre_query result is logged because otherwise a task that promoted 20 rows and one that promoted none emit the identical line.

[MEASURED 2026-09-03] 12 of 39 deployed sites hold no current evidence_base: advertise.co.uk, cookly.uk, cv1.co.uk, designblog.co.uk, garden-tools.uk, homegarden.uk, idea.uk, lampenkap.com, oxenunity.com, seotools.co.uk, vetcomparison.uk, websitepromotion.co.uk.

[MEASURED 2026-09-03] pre_query run three times in one rolled-back transaction: 12/12/0, then 12/0/12 with 12 rows not 24, then 12/1/11 after cancelling one item. loancash.co.uk absent from all three results because migration 738 gave it a register — the discrimination control.

[MEASURED 2026-09-03] four migration guards mutation-killed: task-exists 0->999 aborts; guard 2 pointed at idx_swi_dedup_zzz_absent aborts; verify fire_message expected true aborts; injected 'ON CONFLICT' trips the verify tripwire.

claims.go ScanUnregisteredNumbers:1341 returns nil when eb == nil (an absent register disarms it entirely), and numberSupported consults only Value/ContextTerms/Tolerance — never Source. So an attested register with no citations arms the scan exactly as fully as a cited one.

claims.go ProseNumbersAreClaims() returns false for editorialPageTypes; that map's own doctrine block records the measured false positives that earned each membership (blog-post 46, tool 7, game 4, guide 1+15, news-index 1, cmd/claimscan 2026-07-28) and that section-index was measured and REJECTED.

idx_swi_dedup is UNIQUE on (site_id, item_key) WHERE item_key IS NOT NULL AND status <> ALL(ARRAY['complete','verified','rejected','wont_fix','failed','unresolved','cancelled']) — read from pg_indexes 2026-09-03; the pre_query's NOT EXISTS uses the same seven, and guard 2 aborts if the index stops listing them.

Owner ruling 2026-08-02 §1: converging producers onto one item_type does NOT need an RFC provided the producer set is named in the concept-register entry and the item_key shape is stated there. One producer; both named in CLM-033.
